content.comment_body: Great thread! I managed to install [product_name] on my MacBook Air with Sonoma. However, when I try to open File -> Properties, I get a Java error. Has anyone else encountered this issue? Thank you.
Hello, I suggest checking compatibility between your macOS and the required Java version. Please install the Java runtime specified in this section: [url]. Have a great day.
That solved it! I installed OpenJDK Runtime Environment Corretto-11.0.23.9.1 (build 11.0.23+9-LTS). Thanks very much, this was really helpful.
